title: Lektion 3
generation_notes: Vocabulary was extracted from the supplied Lektion 3 pages and enriched for app use.
Funktionswörter from the book were given specific part-of-speech labels (pronoun, conjunction, particle, preposition, question word).
'mit', 'viel' and 'zu' are listed in the book again but already exist in Lektion 1/2, so they are left out here (kept in the source file).
'verschieden' is listed under Adverbien in the book but is labelled adjective, because it is used like one ('verschiedene Gerichte').
'e Mark' is the former German currency (the book is from before the euro).
Nouns without a plural in the book are stored without a plural (the card shows 'Plural: N/A').
Image searches are suggestions only; for abstract words image_search is null.
Pronunciation audio can be generated on-device from tts_text using German text-to-speech.
